name: Love's Young Dream
source:
The Ashbrook family has always been born beneath an unfortunate star. They aren’t destined to lose their lives at sea, nor lose their fortunes to disaster, however. They are only doomed to lose their first loves to unrequited feelings. No Ashbrook to date has had the luck to prove that curse baseless superstition. 

Yet that doesn’t stop you, the youngest Ashbrook, from trying to defy that fate. Clearly other Ashbrooks of the past just haven’t tried hard enough.

Having fallen in love for the first time, you’ve set yourself to the task of throwing aside a tradition of heartbreak and earning the affection of one Prof. Heron Renaude. With the help of your dearest attendant, and with the backdrop of the romantic Reedford Manor, your brother’s countryside home, surely you’ll prove yourself more powerful than fate.

...Won’t you? 

[From [url=https://bettiqua.itch.io/loves-young-dream]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿什布鲁克家族总是诞生在一个不幸的明星之下。然而，他们注定不会在海上丧生，也不会因灾难而失去财富。他们注定只会因单相思而失去初恋。迄今为止，阿什布鲁克还没有幸运地证明这种诅咒是毫无根据的迷信。

但这并不能阻止你，最年轻的阿什布鲁克，尝试反抗这种命运。显然，过去的其他阿什布鲁克家族还没有足够努力。

第一次坠入爱河后，你就给自己下定决心，要抛开令人心碎的传统，赢得海伦·雷诺德教授的喜爱。在你最亲爱的随从的帮助下，在浪漫的里德福德庄园——你哥哥的乡间别墅的背景下，你一定会证明自己比命运更强大。

…你不会吗？

[来自[url=https://bettiqua.itch.io/loves-young-dream]itch.io[/url]]
